finding: All four helpers fetched and accepted signed index metadata, then the install solver proposed downgrades and the existing noninteractive downgrade protection rejected the transaction. The original source filter restricted package indexes to amd64.
root_cause_mechanism: An explicit source arch=amd64 replaces the default APT architecture list. That suppresses enabled architecture variants such as amd64v3 even when dpkg reports the native architecture as amd64.
interpretation_boundary: These job logs expose the index architectures and rejected solver plan, not a complete installed-package or apt-config dump. The small Ubuntu26 hosted validation is responsible for recording the runner variant policy and corrected installation.
